definition: Hazard awareness, unsafe-action feedback, collision prevention, or immediate driving support
inclusion_examples: collision detection; cyclist/pedestrian warning; unsafe-action alert
boundary_rule: Parking and route guidance are coded as Navigation / mobility unless immediate hazard avoidance is the central meaning

definition: Route, destination, location, parking, points of interest, or spatial journey information
inclusion_examples: parking lots; alternative routes; destination countdown; path to goal
boundary_rule: Environmental imagery without an explicit route or location purpose is coded as Context / environment

definition: State or behaviour of the vehicle itself
boundary_rule: Safety consequences are secondary unless hazard prevention is the stated purpose

definition: Messages, calls, notes, or communication between people or vehicles
inclusion_examples: message summary; digital post-it; message to another car
boundary_rule: General assistant functions are coded as Connected assistance / services

definition: Entertainment, personal media, games, or companion-like playful content
boundary_rule: Atmospheric interface styling without media content is coded as Ambient / interface mode

definition: Background aesthetics, calm or focus modes, adaptive presentation, and interface atmosphere
inclusion_examples: mood background; minimal calm mode; retro particles
boundary_rule: Weather, time, and surroundings are coded as Context / environment when the informational content is primary

definition: Weather, time, road conditions, seasons, or visual information about the surrounding environment
inclusion_examples: weather forecast; analog clock; pictures of surroundings
boundary_rule: Route-specific context is coded as Navigation / mobility

definition: Health, wellbeing, comfort, or occupant-state information
boundary_rule: Mood styling alone is coded as Ambient / interface mode

definition: Digital assistants, reminders, translation, smart-home links, or externally connected services
inclusion_examples: ChatGPT voice; smart home; reminder icons; live translation
boundary_rule: Human-to-human messages are coded as Communication / social
